reviews.text:
We are so happy with Next Step Remodeling.
We had a very bad experience with a previous contractor.
But from the very start of having Parker come in and start talking to us... We knew that this was going to be a very pleasant experience compared to the last one!
We did a whole remodel on our unfinished basement
The whole process was gone over with us, and explained in a way that we understood.
If we needed to make changes on anything or had any questions, they were more than welcome to accommodate us and answered us very promptly.
They also let us know if there was anything on their end that needed to be tweeked or changed(which was very little), we got a text or call right away to let us know.
My wife ended up getting this very large jacuzzi size tub that she really wanted to be implemented into the bathroom build. Parker was able to make her dream bathroom come true!
They were amazing at helping us through the whole process! Even when it came to picking out all of the fixtures, flooring, tile, and more!
We are so pleased with them and their work. We will be using them in the future for any other projects, for sure!!!

10/10 for Next Step Remodeling! We would recommend them to ANYONE looking for ANY size renovation/remodeling.

To start out, we decided on a mid to large scale renovation on our home in Rose Park in 2023. We had several contractors survey and bid for our renovation, and far and away, Next Step Remodeling impressed us from the start. We were remodeling a 3 Bedroom, 1 Bathroom home into a 2 Bed, 2 Bath that needed to go down to bare studs to move walls and doorways around. At the initial meeting, Next Step came to the table with realistic insight and ideas to ensure that our home would be the best finished product we could hope for. Parker was ready to ask the right questions to know which permits needed to be filed and what codes needed to be upheld for our home to be safe and sound for the long term longevity of our home.

We began our remodel in September 2023 with permits from Salt Lake City and insurance paperwork ready. From the beginning of the process, both Parker and Monica were communicative with each step and transparent of the subcontractor(s) they chose. Electricians, plumbers, flooring, and tile subcontractors were punctual and respectful. Through the holidays, delays were unavoidable and understood because everyone deserves time with their families during that time, but the process continued without undue delays.

Our remodel was completed in February 2024, and we could not be happier with the finished product! Each step of the process was completed with care and precision; from the electrical and plumbing, the flooring, and down to the finishing work, it has all been very satisfactory. After the process was completed, Next Step has been very receptive to very minor warranty work. We have a swamp cooler and our doors swell in the summer, so they have been back to adjust the fitment of the doors to ensure they do not stick during the summer. Aside from these unforeseen hiccups, there have not been any further issues with our remodel.

We had a great experience with Parker and Next Step Remodeling during a recent bathroom remodel and flood repair. They redid our bathroom, added a shower, and replaced damaged drywall after a flood. The quality of the work was excellent, and everything turned out better than we expected. Communication throughout the project was clear and consistent, which made the whole process much less stressful. The bid was very reasonable, and there were no surprises along the way. We would definitely recommend Parker and his team for reliable, professional remodeling work.

Parker and the team at Next Step Remodeling remodeled our MIL apartment in 2023, and they did an absolutely incredible job. We honestly couldn’t have been happier with the entire process. We went into the project expecting the usual...

I couldn’t be happier with the bathroom remodel that Next Step Remodeling did for me! From start to finish, the team was professional, communicative, and clearly takes pride in their work. The finished space is absolutely beautiful. They used gorgeous travertine stone throughout and created the double shower-heads setup I had always envisioned. Every detail was executed perfectly. I’ve already recommended them to several friends. If you’re looking for quality craftsmanship and a team that truly listens, I highly recommend Next Step Remodeling!

They built a detached four car RV garage for me and I am very pleased with it. They stuck to the bid with no added up charges and got the job completed in the agreed to time frame. The foreman kept me in the loop through the whole process and I couldn’t be happier with the end result.

Next Step Remodeling helped us achieve our dream expansion of our home. They were delightful to work with and helped coordinate every aspect of our expansion and our new garage. No matter the size of project they can help make it a reality.
Parker helped us get our dream backyard. Very professional and timely. Very responsive!
Next Step Remodeling is the best in the industry. Hands down!
